headline: Indian City Properties appoints Kaustubh Joshi as head-HR
summary: Indian City Properties, the real-estate division of the Karam Chand Thapar Group, has named Kaustubh Joshi as its new Head of Human Resources. In this role, Joshi will oversee the company's people strategy, talent management, and organizational development interventions. He brings over two decades of HR leadership experience from previous roles at Reliance Retail, Sterling & Wilson, Godrej & Boyce, and Voltas.

headline: Oracle trims US workforce AI expansion, offers up to 26 weeks of severance
summary: Oracle has initiated a new round of U.S. workforce reductions to reallocate capital toward artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center expansion. Impacted employees are receiving severance packages capped at 26 weeks, offering a shorter financial runway than recent layoff terms from competitors like Salesforce and Microsoft. The restructuring underscores a broader enterprise tech trend of trimming traditional operational teams to fund aggressive AI investments.

headline: Career lattice: When sideways becomes the new forward
summary: As flatter organizational structures reduce traditional promotion opportunities, companies are increasingly adopting the 'career lattice' model, which encourages lateral and cross-functional employee mobility. This approach enables organizations to retain talent and build well-rounded leaders by prioritizing skill accumulation over linear title progression. However, HR leaders still face challenges in convincing employees that horizontal growth is as valuable as traditional vertical promotion.

headline: Experian promotes Nidhi Arora to country HR head
summary: Global data and technology firm Experian has promoted Nidhi Arora to the position of Country HR Head. Arora, who joined Experian in October 2022, brings over two decades of human resources leadership experience from prior roles at major multinational companies. In her expanded role, she will continue driving enterprise transformation, talent development, and standardized HR practices.

headline: How Dr. Reddy’s is helping build India’s obesity workforce
summary: Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories has launched a nationwide initiative to train over 5,000 Certified Obesity Educators in India, targeting allied healthcare professionals like nurses and dietitians. The program aims to address the country's surging obesity crisis by standardizing patient care and creating specialized job opportunities across clinics and wellness centers. Ultimately, the initiative bridges a critical gap in long-term health management while strengthening India's healthcare talent pipeline.

headline: Why a successor needs more than capability to be ready
summary: Effective succession planning requires aligning an individual's capability and aspiration with the organization's evolving talent needs. According to Jeeva Balakrishnan, CHRO of Cholamandalam Investment & Finance, successful execution relies on the CEO owning the succession strategy while the CHRO builds the underlying infrastructure to develop future leaders.
